hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that enables 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swapping. In beforeSwap, it takes the full input from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert between ETH and phiEth, then settles the output back. Liquidity addition to the pool is blocked. Only ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee may use this hook.
